name: Pettnau
kurzbeschreibung: Municipality in the district of Innsbruck-Land in the Inn Valley west of Innsbruck, characterised by agriculture, commuters and a rural residential character.
beschreibung:
Pettnau is a municipality in the district of Innsbruck-Land in Tyrol, located west of Innsbruck in the Inn Valley. The elongated municipality extends north of the Inn and consists of the hamlets of Dirschenbach, Leiblfing, Tiefental, Unter-, Mitter- and Oberpettnau as well as Kellertal. Around two thirds of its more than ten square kilometres are wooded. Pettnau has around 1,120 inhabitants and belongs to the judicial district of Telfs.

Among the sights are the parish church of Leiblfing (St George) and the subsidiary church of Oberpettnau (St Joseph). The Mellaunerhof has been documented since 1291 and is one of the oldest inns in Tyrol; it formerly served as a salt transhipment point and post station. The Pettnau rest stop is located on the Inntal motorway. The municipality is strongly characterised by commuters, many of whom work in Innsbruck or Telfs.
